name: Quick Fcitx
author: sunny0826
description: Bar widget that shows whether fcitx5 is in Chinese (中) or English (en), toggles it with a single left-Shift tap, and installs, imports, and manages fcitx5 input methods from a panel.

barWidget.description: 中/en fcitx5 state in the bar, left-Shift tap to switch Chinese/English, and a panel to switch, restart, install engines, import Rime schemas, and edit the input-method list.
